country.weights: retain equal pillar weights; normative, not statistically optimal
country.normalization: source bounds, no sample min-max; D2_6_1 /5
country.missing: no cross-construct point imputation; compute lower/upper bounds assuming unknown normalized inputs in [0,1]
country.grades: 12 bands retained provisionally; show grade range and weight stability; do not imply meaningful distinction between unstable adjacent grades
country.weight_sensitivity: 10000 bounded Dirichlet scenarios, seed 20261105, each pillar 0.15–0.35
country.uncertainty_label: weight scenarios and missingness bounds; neither is a sampling confidence interval
country.recipient_audit_scope: three composites D1_1_comp,D4_1_comp,D3_1_1; flags require raw skip-logic review, not proof of bad official data

chemistry.construct: observed sector-specific cooperation experience; not causal synergy or success probability
chemistry.aggregate_status: withheld until harmonization and complete comparable evidence
chemistry.weights_status: not optimized; no adequate common target available
chemistry.unit: independent intervention/evaluation cluster, not IATI activity count or annual observation
chemistry.missing: partial bounds and evidence profile, never replace missing persistence with readiness
chemistry.small_samples: show n and interval; remove former n>=3 as a sufficiency claim; rank only after uncertainty and comparability assessment
chemistry.binomial_interval: Wilson 95%, descriptive assumption-based reference; cannot correct nonrandom evaluation selection
chemistry.prediction: not estimated; future model needs donor/recipient/sector/year baselines, intervention clustering and temporal plus partner-held-out validation
